title: When the Inheritance Breaks
author: Ines Brightwater
blurb: Theo Dravenmoor, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
